turns.text: Hey Lloyd, did you see that new update for Altos Labs' internal ML platform?
Hi Alan. No, I haven't seen any recent updates regarding Altos Labs' internal platforms. Is there something specific you're looking for?
Just curious. Akram Baharlouei is an ML engineer at Altos Labs, so he probably knows all about it.
That makes sense. ML engineers usually have the best insight into those platform changes.
Exactly. Anyway, can you help me debug this Python script? It's throwing a key error on line 42.
Sure, please share the code snippet and the full error traceback.
Here it is: [code snippet]. It works locally but fails in the container.
The issue seems to be a missing environment variable `API_KEY`. You need to export it before running the container.
Ah, got it. Thanks. Also, what's the weather like for my hiking trip next Tuesday?
It looks like partly cloudy with a high of 72°F and light winds. Perfect for hiking.
Lloyd, I'm trying to find more info on that speaker from the AI conference.
Which speaker, Alan? The conference had several presenters.
The one who talked about large language models. Akram Baharlouei's LinkedIn profile is linked in the video description.
Okay, I'll make a note of that for your reference. Did you want me to look up anything specific from his profile?
No, just wanted to make sure I didn't lose the link. By the way, did my package arrive yet?
I don't have access to your personal shipping notifications, but you can check your email or the carrier's website.
Right. Okay, another thing. What's a good substitute for basil in this pasta recipe?
Spinach or arugula work well as substitutes, though they will change the flavor profile slightly.
I'll try arugula. Thanks Lloyd.
You're welcome! Enjoy your dinner.
